verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source classification and acquisition review. Preserve uncertainty and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.
research_scope: Super Kamehameha (SS4 DAIMA) — Ki Blast Ultimate.

verification_audit.method: Cross-checked the dedicated Xenoverse 2 skill documentation, Ultimate Attack index, and Parallel Quest 181 reward listing. The DAIMA variant is kept distinct from the regular Super Kamehameha and other Kamehameha variants.
verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Super Kamehameha (SS4 DAIMA) as a Ki Blast Ultimate used by SS4 Goku (DAIMA), costing 400-500 Ki.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: The skill is listed as a reward from Parallel Quest 181 — The Greatest Training Ever, part of the Dragon Ball DAIMA Pack.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as null because the reviewed reward evidence does not establish an Ultimate Finish-only acquisition requirement.
verification_audit.variant_policy: The DAIMA variant is kept separate from regular Super Kamehameha despite sharing the base name.
verification_audit.damage_policy: No fixed canonical damage value is recorded because the reviewed sources do not establish a stable database-ready value independent of character/build conditions.

records.name: Super Kamehameha (SS4 DAIMA)
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 181 — The Greatest Training Ever
records.skill_description: Charge and fire a full-power Kamehameha; additional input can spend 100 Ki to extend the blast and trigger a stronger cinematic power-up sequence.
records.mechanics_notes: The user gathers energy in the right hand, charges the wave with both hands, then fires it forward. Holding the input while the move prompts for it spends an additional 100 Ki, extending the blast and adding a stronger power-up presentation. The dedicated skill documentation lists the move as beam, extendable, and 12-33 hits.
